analysis.predictor: ten-observation trailing mean contrastive training loss at each saved checkpoint
analysis.outcome: mean nDCG@10 over the 14-task decontaminated BEIR suite at the same checkpoint
scopes: all optimizers within each model family
each optimizer within each model family
analysis.reporting: report DenseOn and LateOn separately; retain all learning-rate points and all five stages

claim_boundary: This diagnostic was added after most discovery retrieval outcomes were visible. It is explicitly post-hoc, descriptive, and excluded from run selection and confirmatory sign claims. A lower contrastive training loss is never treated as evidence of better zero-shot retrieval without the paired BEIR result.
